newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent Group Three basis moves higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent Group Three basis moves higher.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent low sulphur diesel and unleaded gasoline basis continued to move higher in Group Three despite generally bearish inventory projections, traders said on Wednesday.

The run-up in Group Three differentials was pegged to spot buying by Gulf Coast refiners Exxon and Citgo, which appeared to be covering trimmed production from the 265,000 barrel per day Lyondell-Citgo Refining Co refinery in Houston.
A refinery spokeswoman said one of three sulphur recovery units was operating after an upset yesterday released noxious gases over a Houston neighborhood.
Traders questioned the run-up in Group differentials in light of ample stocks in the Williams pipeline system.
"I would think the Group is going to stall here," one trader said.
Group Three low sulphur diesel was bid 1.25 cents a gallon under NYMEX February heating oil for prompt deliveries and 0.25 cent weaker for late-month deliveries, traders said.
Chicago low sulphur was talked 3.25/3.0 cents a gallon under the print for all timings as trade in January barrels wound down.
High sulphur diesel basis firmed to 6.75 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three and 4.50 cents under the print in Chicago, traders said.
Unleaded gasoline basis was talked 1.50/1.0 cents a gallon under NYMEX February unleaded in Group Three and 1.75/1.50 cents under the print in Chicago.
